title: GOUR — Chat. Build. Launch.
excerpt: Describe your app in plain English and GOUR builds, runs, and launches it.
content_html:
Whether it's an idea, a task, or something your team's been putting off — turning it into a working app usually means weeks of setup before you even know if it's worth doing.

Writing the code. Wiring up a database. Getting the pieces to actually talk to each other. Most of these projects stall right here — not because they're bad, but because building the first version takes too long and costs too much just to find out.

By the time you have something to show, you've already spent the time and budget you needed to actually test it.
